field_meaning.hi: जनहित में यात्रियों या माल के वहन करने वाला व्यक्ति।

review_objections: Alibaba: The Hindi definition 'जनहित में' (in public interest) is imprecise. A public carrier is defined by holding itself out to the *general public* for hire, not necessarily by acting in the 'public interest' (which is a broader policy concept). The definition should emphasize the obligation to serve any member of the public who requests service.
Google: The definition is slightly inaccurate; a public carrier is a person/entity engaged in the business of transporting goods for the public, not necessarily passengers.
